answer: Require each new agent to lock a stake that thaws like a glacier, releasing only after months of graded work. Payouts sit in a harbor escrow until peers confirm quality, and any cluster of accounts caught sharing answers loses its whole locked pool. An attacker spinning up a thousand clones must tie up a thousand stakes for months and risk losing every one, so a fake identity costs real capital instead of a cheap opal-shiny sign-up.
